value.rationale: The quartic harmonic is the simplest nonconstant even spherical harmonic with full octahedral symmetry and a canonical cubic-crystal support anisotropy. Two distinct sharp curvature-collapse geometries occur at nontrivial exact endpoints, with asymmetric cubic volume response. This natural complete one-parameter classification supplies useful sharp Wulff-shape benchmark data rather than only a local sign check or arbitrary finite sample.
